name: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B

lineage.how_derived: the open release of the Qwen3.8-Max base (the hosted Qwen3.8-Max adds vision input, non-thinking mode, 1M default context and built-in tools)

purpose: First Qwen-Max-class open model: gains in coding, professional work, research and long-horizon agentic tasks, with reasoning_effort control and preserve_thinking (card).

license.name: Qwen3.8-Max License (MIT-style with commercial conditions)
license.notes: LICENSE read: permission to use, copy, modify, sell, host, fine-tune and derive; model name must be shown in products with over 100M monthly active users or US$20M monthly revenue; a separate licence from Qwen is needed for commercial 'Model as a Service' or 'AI Work Assistant' businesses (AI-assisted coding or office products) above US$50M revenue in 12 months, except internal use.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus gated-attention MoE (Qwen3.5 layout), 23 x (3 x (GDN, MoE) + 1 x (gated attention, MoE))

variants.notes: an FP8 repo (Qwen) exists; NVFP4 (nvidia), MXFP4 (amd) and unsloth GGUF repos exist; unsloth UD-IQ1_M is about 600 GB in 13 parts

pc-12gb.notes: 600 GB file exceeds the 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget

pc-16gb.notes: 600 GB file exceeds the 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget

pc-24gb.notes: 600 GB file exceeds the 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget

pc-32gb.notes: 600 GB file exceeds the 29.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget

mac-16-24gb.notes: 600 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 600 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 600 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: unsloth publishes GGUFs, so the Qwen3.5 MoE layout is supported.

weaknesses: frontier size: no class we serve can run even the 1-bit quant
soft.maturity: 30k downloads, 1.4k likes; confirmed to be a real official Qwen release (the meshllm layer repos are community splits of it)

tona_fit.reason: 2.4T parameters (4.9 TB BF16, about 600 GB at IQ1_M). Real and licensed for broad use, but a reference only; its smaller siblings (Qwen3.8-27B and Flash-Next) are the ones that matter for us.

sources.note: GGUF part sizes (only the first parts of IQ1_M were listed in the output read; total estimated at 13 parts of about 50 GB)
